class.name: SceneryModelPlacement
class.brief_description: A decoration model supplied by a [SceneryStreamingProvider].
class.description: An item of [constant SceneryStreamingProvider.CONTENT_MODELS]: a model drawn while its cell is supplied, registered with [method E3DRenderingServer.instance_register] and streamed by its own range. It is named by nothing, so no event or signal reaches it.

members.member: Where the model and its textures are, relative to the game directory.
The model file, without its extension.
The distance it is drawn up to [m]; [code]0[/code] or less is no limit of its own (the streaming's draw distance).
The distance it is drawn from [m].
The model's replaceable materials, by number.
Where the model stands in the world.
